Building and Running

The examples are in the examples folder and are built with the library by CMake:

cmake -S . -B cmake-build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build cmake-build -j
cmake-build/examples/db_infohog          # Linux
cmake-build\examples\Release\db_infohog  # Windows

The database examples pause for Enter between steps; give them empty input (< /dev/null or < nul) to run straight through. The TLS servers need a certificate and key; see Certificates for making test ones. tests/run_tests.sh builds everything and runs the examples against each other and against mock mail and FTPS servers.

Object database

examples/database/simple/testprog.cpp

db_simple: gxDatabase basics: create a file, allocate, write, read and delete blocks, file statistics.

examples/database/database/testprog.cpp

db_database: Store and find fixed-size objects in a gxDatabase file.

examples/database/btree/testprog.cpp

db_btree: gxBtree index with a custom key class: insert, find, walk in order, delete.

examples/database/btree_cached/testprog.cpp

db_btree_cached: The same B-tree operations through a BtreeCache.

examples/database/btree_node/testprog.cpp

db_btree_node: Inside a B-tree node: key layout and branches.

examples/database/database_cache/testprog.cpp

db_database_cache: gxDatabaseCache write-back cache over a database file.

examples/database/defrag/testprog.cpp

db_defrag: Free-space reuse and rebuilding (defragmenting) a database file.

examples/database/pod/testprog.cpp

db_pod: POD: a data file with one or several index files opened together.

examples/database/infohog/infohog.cpp

db_infohog: InfoHog object database: records with a key and variable members, add, find, change, delete, list and reopen.

examples/database/rdbms/rdbms.cpp

db_rdbms: gxRDBMS relational table: primary and secondary keys, find, change, search and a sorted listing.

TLS networking

examples/tls/tls_echo_server.cpp

tls_echo_server: TLS server using gxsTLSServer and a ThreadPool. Usage: tls_echo_server port cert.pem key.pem

examples/tls/tls_echo_client.cpp

tls_echo_client: TLS client with certificate checking. Usage: tls_echo_client host port [--ca ca.pem] [--insecure]

examples/tls/https_get.cpp

https_get: Fetch a URL or download a file with gxsHTTPClient. Usage: https_get url [file] [--ca ca.pem]

examples/tls/https_server.cpp

https_server: Small HTTPS file server built on gxsHTTPReadRequest() and gxsHTTPWriteResponse().

examples/tls/smtp_send.cpp

smtp_send: Send mail over implicit TLS or STARTTLS.

examples/tls/pop3_list.cpp

pop3_list: List and read a POP3 mailbox over TLS.

examples/tls/ftps_client.cpp

ftps_client: List, download and upload with FTPS.

examples/tls/stream_server.cpp

stream_server: gxStream server that stores client blocks in a gxDatabase file.

examples/tls/stream_client.cpp

stream_client: gxStream client that stores and reads back blocks over TLS.

General support

examples/general/config_file.cpp

config_file: gxConfig: write, read and change a configuration file.

examples/general/logfile.cpp

logfile: LogFile shared by several threads.

examples/general/thread_pool.cpp

thread_pool: ThreadPool tasks, results and exceptions.

Plain text diagnostics

examples/diagnostics/ping.cpp

ping: ICMP and ICMPv6 echo. Usage: ping host [count] [-4|-6]

examples/diagnostics/telnet_client.cpp

telnet_client: Telnet login and command (plain text; trusted networks only).
